ModMetaData.name: RimTalk.DisplayOptimization
ModMetaData.author: OCEAN
ModMetaData.description: 增强 RimTalk 的对话显示效果，包括涂色，内容转换等。还能调节对话速度，暂停说话，防止忽略，智能暂停等 Enhance the dialogue display effects of RimTalk, including coloring, content conversion, and more. It also allows you to adjust dialogue speed, pause speech, prevent skipping, and enable smart pauses.
